No class-diagram skill was available, so I built this by hand from the production sources. Four classes refer to `Visit` (`Pet`, `Owner` and `VisitController`, plus its superclass `BaseEntity`). The only other project class it uses is `BaseEntity`; its other field types are `LocalDate` and `String`.

```mermaid
classDiagram
    direction LR

    class BaseEntity {
        -Integer id
        +getId() Integer
        +setId(Integer id) void
        +isNew() boolean
    }

    class Visit {
        <<Entity>>
        -LocalDate date
        -String description
        +Visit()
        +getDate() LocalDate
        +setDate(LocalDate date) void
        +getDescription() String
        +setDescription(String description) void
    }

    class Pet {
        <<Entity>>
        -LocalDate birthDate
        -PetType type
        -Set~Visit~ visits
        +getVisits() Collection~Visit~
        +addVisit(Visit visit) void
    }

    class Owner {
        <<Entity>>
        -List~Pet~ pets
        +getPet(Integer id) Pet
        +addVisit(Integer petId, Visit visit) void
    }

    class VisitController {
        <<Controller>>
        -OwnerRepository owners
        +loadPetWithVisit(int ownerId, int petId, Map model) Visit
        +initNewVisitForm() String
        +processNewVisitForm(Owner owner, int petId, Visit visit, BindingResult result, RedirectAttributes redirectAttributes) String
    }

    BaseEntity <|-- Visit : extends
    Pet "1" *-- "0..*" Visit : visits
    Owner ..> Visit : addVisit(petId, visit)
    VisitController ..> Visit : creates / validates
```
